builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Final Spark direct beam within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.

builds.name: Prismatic Barrier: outgoing and return shield
builds.summary: Investigate high Prismatic Barrier capacity after both passes output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Prismatic Barrier capacity after both passes output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each pass grants 40/55/70/85/100 + 0.4 AP shielding for 2.5 seconds; the returning wand grants the same shield. Two fully additive overlapping layers would nominally be 200 + 0.8 AP at rank 5, but stacking versus refreshing and consumed first-layer capacity must be verified rather than assumed.

ceiling.targetName: Prismatic Barrier capacity after both passes
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Recipient ally: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 30%, observation 2.5s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed. One ally at 30% health and no prior shield is struck by both outbound and return passes of one W. Place the ally so the return arrives before the first shield expires, and measure capacity immediately afterward within 2.5 seconds of the first pass. No damage consumed between passes for the clean control.

builds.name: Illumination: beam refresh and attack cashout
builds.summary: Explore high two legal Illumination mark consumptions output with explicit finite conditions; compare item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high two legal Illumination mark consumptions output with explicit finite conditions; compare item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each Illumination consumption uses a level-table base + 0.35 AP magic damage. Final Spark consumes a pre-existing mark and refreshes it, enabling a later attack to consume a second mark. The two passive packets are distinct from E, R beam and the physical attack.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy reference: 20000 maximum HP, 100 armor, 50 MR, 100% starting HP. Owner at 100% HP. No dragons, elixirs or external allied stat buffs. Record final stats, actual eligibility and per-packet state; keep raw and effective results separate and stop scoring damage at death. Seraph legitimately transformed. Exactly 10 earned Rod stacks. Start the overall setup on the full-health benchmark target. Apply one legal mark with E, hit R while that mark is alive, then attack once within the refreshed six-second mark duration. Selected scoring counts only the two actual passive consumptions within four seconds; log all preparation and beam damage separately.
